# hello-tool SDK

Provides the hello-tool CLI inside workshops.

## Usage

```yaml
# workshop.yaml
name: dev
base: ubuntu@24.04
sdks:
  - name: hello-tool
```

Upstream: https://github.com/example/hello-tool (semver release tags).
